name: Blanca Nava
office: Keppel Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Blanca Nava is a member of the Keppel Union School District Governing Board and serves as its vice president. She was elected in November 2022. She has also served as board president. Nava completed the California School Boards Association’s Masters in Governance program in 2025.

sentences.text: Blanca Nava is a member of the Keppel Union School District Governing Board and serves as its vice president.
She has also served as board president.
Nava completed the California School Boards Association’s Masters in Governance program in 2025.

items.text: In 2023, Nava voted with two other trustees to terminate the superintendent's contract without cause. In 2026, the board she serves on voted to place a $27 million bond measure on the November ballot, with an estimated tax rate of $30 per $100,000 of assessed valuation.
